title: The Mutated
description: This Mod adds a lot of new things to discover, a dimension, many unique items and mobs. This is the future of a polluted world. It is an infection.
body: This Mod adds an Acidic, Polluted infection in the world. This infection only triggers by player input, this mod contains: A Custom dimension replicating vanilla minecraft mobs, blocks, items, biomes and more in a distorted, mutated way. There are many mechanics and items to discover in this mod, Enjoy! (In Beta)
